Decision rationale: THE PROBLEM: Outer Race Fault detected at severity 'critical' on bearing BRG_001 (asset AST_MTR_001). Remaining useful life estimate: ~0 days. Stage 3 / high severity indicates imminent failure — intervention is critical.

THE RECOMMENDATION: Action: replace_bearing (now) per SOP_001. Required part SKF6310-ZZ is confirmed in stock — the repair can proceed without delay. Timing: immediate — no planned window required.

THE REASONING: This action was selected as the highest-scoring feasible option from 1 candidate evaluated. Immediate action was scored highest because the remaining useful life is short and the required resources are available now.
